description: Register a new feature in the project. Writes feature.json and regenerates ROADMAP.md (audit-log append is best-effort). Use this instead of editing ROADMAP.md by hand.

code.description: Unique feature code (e.g. "COMP-FOO-1"). Must be uppercase A-Z, digits, dashes; cannot start or end with a dash.

description.description: One-line description for the ROADMAP cell

force.description: Bypass the pre-commit roundtrip guard (commit even if ROADMAP.md would not be a generation fixed point).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-provided key. Same key replays return the cached result without re-mutating.

impact.description: Estimated impact, carried from the plan/ideabox estimation step.

plannedBy.description: Originating plan session code (e.g. "PLAN-WIDGET"). Marks a plan-authored, build-ready feature.

profile.description: Triage build profile (needs_prd/needs_architecture/etc.). Set by the plan lifecycle so build can skip fresh triage.

triageTimestamp.description: Triage cache stamp (ISO 8601). Set AFTER design.md is written so build treats triage as a cached no-op.

name: add_roadmap_entry
